rows.notes: [T056] dated floor (D-025): Xinhua 2018-06-27 (opening day, company event) says the plant 'currently has' 10 GWh/yr with seven lines and is designed for 24 GWh by 2019 (S1). installed basis: company (opening statement, reported by Xinhua). Series A carries 10 GWh from 2018; current installed is almost certainly higher (24 GWh design, 2019 target) but no later source states it. Nameplate 24 now confirmed by S1 (was CleanTechnica 2018); ref_year changed from publication-year fallback 2018 to the dated phase target 2019 (S1). capacity_by_year_json = the two stated steps (2018 in operation, 2019 target), no interpolation. CONFLICT: People's Daily client 2026-02-01 (S2) says '弗迪公司于2023年投产，当年就满产' for the Qinghai Fudi cell workshop in Nanchuan, Xining (a cell every 4 s) - this contradicts a 2018 start and may refer to a separate/new Qinghai Fudi line; status operational is supported by S2 as well. start_year (2018, v1 reported) left untouched. Other fields (chemistry, format, end_market) untouched, remain reported per T031. ESCALATE: >=10 GWh below 0.6 (dated and conflicting sources).

[T056] dated floor (D-025): Gasgoo 2021-12-13 states the first phase of 10 GWh (ternary lithium) of the Xi'an plant 'was put into production in 2019' (S3); installed_as_of 2019-12-31 is the end of the stated year (source gives no day). installed basis: press (Gasgoo). Status operational now confirmed (was reported tier / D-016 only); start_year corrected 2022 -> 2019 on the same quote. Gasgoo also says the second phase (reportedly blade) was still under construction as of an official reply in Nov 2020; no later page found stating its completion, so installed stays at the 10 GWh floor. Nameplate 30 (Xueqiu aggregator, weak) and ref_year 2025 left untouched; Shaanxi S&T dept page 2026-01-23 cited by v1 (full production of 30 GWh) returned HTTP 503 - not verified. Separate Xixian/Qinhan base (16 GWh) is another row. ESCALATE: >=10 GWh below 0.6.

[T056] dated floor (D-025): Gasgoo 2022-04-02 quotes the Guiyang Fudi project manager: six battery lines, 15 GWh/yr, base already in operation (S7). installed basis: company (project manager quoted by press). Floor dated 2022-04; likely higher/lower today unknown. Nameplate 20 GWh (Xueqiu aggregator 'full output', T003) is not confirmed by any page I could fetch and is left untouched; Gasgoo 2021-12-13 (S3 page) described the Guiyang project as 10 GWh blade, so 10 -> 15 -> 20 plan figures conflict; the same S7 article announces a new-type battery project with no GWh figure (not counted). Guiyang Fudi (贵阳弗迪电池) and Gui'an (贵安新区弗迪电池) both appear in BYD's 2025 filing lists; still stored as one row. ESCALATE: 20 GWh nameplate weak; >=10 GWh below 0.6.

[T056] Yicai 2025-12-04 (S4): 一期建成30GWh动力电池及零部件项目, whole park planned at 50 GWh, output value expected RMB16bn in 2025; products supply Dongfeng/BYD plants and exports. CnEVPost 2022-12-20 citing Hubei Daily (S5): first line (1.9 GWh) started 2022-12-15, all 16 lines due May 2023, site 30 GWh (cell lines). installed 30 GWh as of publication date 2025-12-04; installed basis: press (Yicai, 'built' capacity; the Yicai phrase bundles cells with parts, the 30 GWh matches the cell-line figure in S5). Nameplate raised 30 -> 50 (D-014: stated site plan 50 GWh 动储电池; remaining 20 GWh undated; ref_year: fallback, searched = publication year 2025). Earlier row said 'status unconfirmed, 30 GWh stale' - now confirmed operational. Other fields untouched.

[T056] EnergyTrend 2024-09-12 (S6) lists three Nanning BYD battery projects totalling 70 GWh: Yongning Industrial Park 10 GWh power-battery expansion ('fully operational'), East New City Lingli 45 GWh and ASEAN zone (Wuming) 10+5 GWh (both 'partially operational'). I map this row (南宁弗迪电池有限公司) to the Yongning 10 GWh expansion; the mapping is an inference from the entity names (Guangxi Fudi = Lingli 45 GWh per S8/filing, Guangxi-ASEAN Fudi = Wuming) and is not stated by the source, hence confidence 0.4. installed basis: press (EnergyTrend, no company/government text seen). The 10 GWh is both installed and full plan (nameplate); ref_year: fallback, searched = 2024 publication year. A 2022 snippet mentioning a 'Nanning Yongzhou' expansion with a 1 GWh figure (10亿瓦时?) could not be opened; unit conflict unresolved. If the mapping is wrong the 10 GWh still belongs to a real BYD Nanning site that has no other row.

[T056] Guangxi Fudi (Nanning, Lingli Industrial Park; BYD's 2025 filing lists 广西弗迪电池有限公司 under Nanning): project '广西弗迪年产45GWh动力电池及储能系统项目', RMB14bn (S8, 2022-04-13); production started 2023-05 ('项目于2023年5月投产', S9, 2025-02-19); EnergyTrend 2024-09-12 calls the 45 GWh Lingli project 'partially operational' (S6). Installed not quantified: no source states how many GWh are producing -> installed null (do not assume). Nameplate 45 GWh (S8 plan, repeated in S6; full plan, ref_year: fallback, searched = 2024 publication of S6; S8 says full capacity within ~3 years of start, not a dated phase). Row bundles power-battery cells and ESS systems per S8 title; 45 GWh is quoted as battery capacity - treat with care. Also S9: a 2025-02-18 '三模块' project adds ~7 GWh (module-type, not clearly cells; not counted). Companion rows: Nanning (10 GWh Yongning) and Guangxi-ASEAN (15 GWh).

[T056] Cailian 2022-09-13 (S12): 10 GWh hybrid-vehicle battery + 5 GWh new-type battery = 15 GWh planned, construction from 2022-09-09. EnergyTrend 2024-09-12 (S6) lists the ASEAN-zone (Wuming) 10+5 GWh projects among the three Nanning projects (70 GWh in total) and says the 45 GWh and ASEAN projects are 'partially operational' - quote fragment in S6 is the page's sentence for the two non-expansion projects; the page text naming Wuming/ASEAN was summarised by the fetch tool, not copied verbatim, hence confidence 0.4. Status operational (partial) from S6; installed not quantified -> null. ref_year changed 2022 -> 2024 (publication year of latest source stating the plan; ref_year: fallback, searched).

[T056] Sina Finance / 电池工业网 2025-08-06 (S10): 'BYD New Energy Power Battery Yangtze River Delta Manufacturing Center' is advancing in phases: 一期 RMB2.8bn, 年产刀片电池10GWh; 二期 规划产能15GWh; 三期 (EIA pre-approval notice Aug 2025) RMB2.4bn makes battery packs 184,800/yr, steel/aluminium trays and cooling plates - no GWh, pack/parts, excluded (D-026). The page does not state that phases 1-2 are in production or give an acceptance date (v1 timeline claims phase 1 online Jan 2022 / phase 2 accepted May 2023 from the same URL, which I could not confirm), so installed stays null and status stays at the D-016 entity-list level (<=0.4). The 无为弗迪 entity carries RMB-bn bank guarantees dated 2023-12 to 2025-03 in BYD's 2025 report (company is a going concern). start_year 2024 (v1 reported) untouched/unconfirmed.
